name: LLM Wiki Manager
description: Manage a persistent, compounding markdown wiki using the llm-wiki-manager pattern. Use this tool to run the core Python scripts: init_wiki.py (bootstrap wiki), append_log.py (append to log.md), update_index.py (upsert index.md entries), and lint_wiki.py (health check).
author: sametbrr (Ported to AnythingLLM)

input.hint: Python executable to use (e.g., python, python3)

script_name.description: The exact name of the Python script to execute (e.g. 'init_wiki.py', 'lint_wiki.py', 'append_log.py', 'update_index.py').

arguments_string.description: The command line arguments to pass to the script, formatted as a single space-separated string. Leave empty if no arguments are needed.

examples.prompt: Bootstrap a new LLM wiki in the current directory.
Run a health check on the wiki and output to stdout.
